name: Humbert's Sword
summary: At Dun Garok, Humbert's Sword lies among the dwarves who took it from his camp. Deathguard Humbert left his post to gather firewood while scouting the stronghold.

sections.title: A Scout's Careless Moment
sections.body: Deathguard Humbert left his hidden post near Dun Garok one morning to gather firewood for boiling water. High Executor Darthalia had sent him to watch the dwarven presence there. While he was away, a dwarven patrol found his campsite and plundered his gear, including his personal blade. With so many dwarves to search, Humbert needs Horde agents to enter the fortress and recover it.

sections.title: The Dwarven Trove
sections.body: Dun Garok's defenders carried Humbert's belongings behind the stronghold's barricades. Riflemen, mountaineers, and priests pass supplies around the garrison. Finding the thief means searching among the defenders in the trenches and redoubts.

faq.answer: The sword belongs to Deathguard Humbert, a Forsaken sentry stationed in Tarren Mill and assigned to scout Dun Garok.

faq.q: How did the dwarves get Humbert's sword?
faq.answer: Humbert left his scout camp just outside Dun Garok one morning to gather firewood. While he was away, a dwarven patrol ransacked the camp and took his gear.

faq.q: Why is Humbert so desperate to get his sword back?
aliases: what happens if humbert loses sword
faq.answer: Humbert needs his weapon to keep watch on Dun Garok as High Executor Darthalia ordered. With so many dwarves in the garrison, he cannot find the thief alone.

faq.q: Where can the sword be found?
faq.answer: The sword is with the dwarven forces at Dun Garok in southeastern Hillsbrad Foothills. It can be recovered from the mountaineers, riflemen, or priests stationed throughout the post.

angles.text: High Executor Darthalia keeps strict discipline over the Forsaken forces in Hillsbrad. Negligent sentries like Humbert are desperate to hide their mistakes.
Recovering the sword fits the Horde's wider operations against Dun Garok's dwarven enclave, including collecting dwarven blood and military insignias.
